output.reason: The release note [ev-cb27e256d164] is vague on its own, but the linked PR [ev-d6ed6f4111c6] shows the fix touched only one file, test/container/Dockerfile. The PR's description [ev-b153b7efc31d] [ev-082e9e360f94] is just a checklist that ticks the bug-fix box and leaves the docs-update item unchecked. Together these are enough to type the change: the subject is the permissions inside the developer test-container image used by `make codegen`. That makes it development and build tooling, not a shipped component, so no customer environment is exposed and an operator who does nothing sees no effect. The exact before and after Dockerfile permissions, and issue #21623, are not shown. That gap doesn't change the applicability or consequence, but it is why confidence is low.
